@@VERSION
ufw 0.36.2
@@VERBOSE
Status: active
Logging: on (medium)
Default: deny (incoming), allow (outgoing), deny (routed)
New profiles: skip

To                         Action      From
--                         ------      ----
22/tcp                     REJECT IN   198.51.100.8               # reject ssh
Anywhere                   DENY IN     198.51.100.7               # blocked first
22/tcp                     ALLOW IN    Anywhere                   # SSH
53                         ALLOW IN    Anywhere                   # DNS
6000:6007/tcp              ALLOW IN    10.0.0.0/8                 # X11 range
Anywhere                   DENY IN     203.0.113.4                # bad host
Anywhere on eth0           ALLOW IN    Anywhere                   # on eth0
192.168.1.10 443/tcp on eth0 ALLOW IN    Anywhere                   # https eth0
22/tcp (OpenSSH)           ALLOW IN    Anywhere                   # app profile
80,443/tcp                 ALLOW IN    Anywhere                   # Città web
22/tcp (v6)                ALLOW IN    Anywhere (v6)              # SSH
53 (v6)                    ALLOW IN    Anywhere (v6)              # DNS
Anywhere (v6) on eth0      ALLOW IN    Anywhere (v6)              # on eth0
22/tcp (OpenSSH (v6))      ALLOW IN    Anywhere (v6)              # app profile
80,443/tcp (v6)            ALLOW IN    Anywhere (v6)              # Città web

8.8.8.8 53/udp             ALLOW OUT   Anywhere                   # out dns

@@ADDED
Added user rules (see 'ufw status' for running firewall):
ufw reject from 198.51.100.8 to any port 22 proto tcp comment 'reject ssh'
ufw deny from 198.51.100.7 comment 'blocked first'
ufw allow 22/tcp comment 'SSH'
ufw allow 53 comment 'DNS'
ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/8 to any port 6000:6007 proto tcp comment 'X11 range'
ufw deny from 203.0.113.4 comment 'bad host'
ufw allow in on eth0 comment 'on eth0'
ufw allow in on eth0 to 192.168.1.10 port 443 proto tcp comment 'https eth0'
ufw allow OpenSSH comment 'app profile'
ufw allow out to 8.8.8.8 port 53 proto udp comment 'out dns'
ufw allow 80,443/tcp comment 'Città web'
